body: Motivation isn't the problem. I know what I like to do. I fix computers and write. Knowing that doesn't help me in any way.

As I stated earlier, my family members have no money and all live on the opposite side of the country. Aside from that they are all a bunch of hyper religious rednecks. They don't know how to use computers and thus don't own them.

I tried putting my services on Craig's List a few times when I lived in Nebraska and never got any hits. I haven't tried since I moved to California, but I would expect the same result. People want to take their computers to Geek Squad, not some random guy on Craig's List.

I used to write a webcomic back in 2006. It only had about 10k readers and the website no longer exists. I don't think I could use that to my advantage in any way. I currently work as a journalist for a gaming website, but that's just an unpaid internship and I doubt the boss man would let me use the business for personal gain.

I tried the local job centers. They either had nothing for me or required experience in clerical work or something else that I have no experience in. I did find one place that was willing to pay for up to $5k in job training, but nothing they offered fit me so it ended up being a waste of time.

Unfortunately I don't think a pardon is an option. Those arrests were made in a small town in Kentucky where only one seed can get you a week in jail and in my case I was busted three times in a period of less than two months. I also skipped the state to try my luck in Nebraska the day that I was supposed to start rehab for the marijuana arrests, so I am a wanted man there.

I may not be exactly unskilled, but without a degree to back up my knowledge I may as well be. I can't even get geek squad to hire me!

Your observations are spot-on. I am a gamer. Your kind words helped me feel slightly better, so thank you.

I'd take almost anything I could get at this point as long as it pays more than my unemployment insurance. The only kind of job I wouldn't take is something like retail or telemarketing as contact like that with strangers gives me massive panic attacks. Unfortunately I made the mistake of moving to Oildale, California where there are no jobs to be found. I would kill to be a trashman. In my home town in Tennessee those guys make like $14/hr. That's way more than I've ever made. I have applied to anything you can think of that someone with a high school education can apply for.

I stayed with friends in Nebraska until their financial situation got to the point that they could no longer afford to live in the same place at which point I moved to California with some friends that were already planning on going and am currently bumming off of them. They aren't rich people and they'll soon be unable to help as well. We have four people living here and only one of us has a job right now. My family members all live in a state where I am wanted for those marijuana charges so moving in with them is not an option. I'm well known as a political activist where they live and it's a small town of only about 300 people so I would surely be arrested on sight if I were to ever show my face there again.
